title: Land Lease, Application Administrator: reachable, commands and rows as canvas, out-of-scope write refused visibly
preconditions: One account holding only the role "VSB - Application Administrator" (saved session per account in e2e/.auth/), signed in to both apps. In-scope project: a project of any business unit and country. A non-standard contract on the in-scope project.
test_data: In-scope write: Add Contract Type with Description PW-<runId>-acc-contract, EUR/WTG 1000, 1 year 0 months, first frequency (deleted afterwards). Out-of-scope write: the same on the out-of-scope project.
steps:
1. Run steps 2-n in the Canvas app first and note the result (reference).
2. Open the Cost app on the in-scope project and open Land Lease from the left navigation (OPEX > Land Lease); repeat with the launch parameters projectId + costScreen=/costs/land-lease.
3. Open each card in turn and record the five command captions and their enabled state; select row 0 of a card with rows and record them again.
4. Record the card titles and the period rows (Description, Start Date) per card.
5. Create the in-scope test contract and delete it again.
6. Open the out-of-scope project (deep link) and try the same create (and an Edit / Delete of an existing period).
7. Read any message, the [VSB] ERROR line and the rows after a reload.
expected: The Cost app reads no role in any Land Lease screen, command or gate (gblCurrentUser is built in App OnStart but never read on this screen), so: the screen is reachable for the role; every command's caption and enabled state equal the Canvas for the same user and project; the rows shown equal the Canvas rows for that user (Dataverse business-unit scope). A write outside the role's Dataverse scope is refused by the server and the code app shows the refusal as an error message (banner / [VSB] ERROR), never as 'no rows' or a silent success (D1). For a role with organisation-wide scope no refusal is expected; record that step as not applicable.
acceptance: Screen reachable in both apps AND command states per card equal AND row lists per card equal AND (out-of-scope write: code app error shown AND no row created) for the role.
canvas_ref: App.pa.yaml OnStart gblCurrentUser (App.pa.yaml:205; varCurrentUserProfile App.pa.yaml:60); LeftNavigationMenu LandLeaseKey (App.pa.yaml:111); pcf_con_LandLease_Content_Subaccounts_CardBody_SubaccountsCommandBar_1.Items DataSourceInfo / RecordInfo (Land Lease Costs Screen.pa.yaml:221)
divergence_ref: D1 (DataSourceInfo / RecordInfo replaced by the server refusing; a 403 becomes a message)
comments: Manual: the parity harness runs with one service account; a run per role needs an account per role (FUNCTIONAL-TEST-CASES Part 2). The Land Lease YAML has no gblCurrentUser reference (grep 4 Nov 2026).
